# Charlotta & Lavendar Lewis

- [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) — Commands — [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) — help and companion · since v2  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> School resumes, where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) deal with [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and Dora's first days and Mirabel Cotton's ghost stories. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) get lost on their way to a tea party and discover [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), where they are invited to stay for tea by the eccentric Miss Lavendar [Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and her maid [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md).
>
> — v2 · XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P8](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0008), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P49](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0049)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) enjoy a charming tea party with Miss Lavendar and her young assistant, Charlotta the Fourth. After showing off her echoes in the garden and explaining Charlotta's name, Miss Lavendar becomes suddenly quiet and worn when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) casually mentions [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md). The girls take their leave, promising to visit again soon.
>
> — v2 · XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P64](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0064), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P71](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0071), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P81](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0081), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P87](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0087)_

> At [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) dinner, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) chatted with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) about [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), school pranks, and marriage until [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) laughed herself out to the cellar hatch. Afterwards, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) walked to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) to visit Miss Lavendar and Charlotta the Fourth, enjoying lunch, playing with echoes, and gathering wild strawberries.
>
> — v2 · XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House

_Sources: [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P1](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0001), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P7](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0007), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P22](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0022), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P35](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0035)_

> While berry picking, [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) confides in [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about her worries over Miss Lavendar's melancholy mood and changed behavior. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) promises to come stay at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) during her vacation to help cheer Miss Lavendar up. Later, while having tea in the garden, [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) talks with Miss Lavendar about her imaginary dream-boy before [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) head home.
>
> — v2 · XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House

_Sources: [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P49](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0049), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P51](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0051), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P59](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0059)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits Miss Lavendar at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) before returning to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), where she meets Paul's father, [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md). Stephen asks [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to inquire if he may visit Miss Lavendar, leading [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to carry a message and help Miss Lavendar prepare for his arrival.
>
> — v2 · XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace

_Sources: [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P17](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0017), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P21](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0021), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P35](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0035), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P57](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0057)_

> [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) arrives at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) to visit Miss Lavendar. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) greets him at the door and ushers him inside to meet Miss Lavendar. Afterwards, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) watch from the window and celebrate when they see Stephen and Miss Lavendar walking together affectionately in the garden.
>
> — v2 · XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace

_Sources: [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P59](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0059), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P64](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0064), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P70](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0070), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P71](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0071)_

> As preparations for Miss Lavendar's wedding get underway, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discusses the romantic turn of events with [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), Charlotta the Fourth, and a skeptical [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally discovers that [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md) are in love, leading [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) to visit [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to confide her engagement details to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md).
>
> — v2 · XXIX Poetry and Prose

_Sources: [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P0](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0000), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P5](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0005), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P11](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0011), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P15](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0015)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) help Miss Lavendar and Charlotta the Fourth prepare for Miss Lavendar's wedding at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). The ceremony goes wonderfully as the sun breaks through the clouds, and the guests see off the newlyweds. Afterwards, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) waits with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) at the quiet house, where a moment of realization sparks a shift in how she perceives [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and her own maturity.
>
> — v2 · XXX A Wedding at the Stone House

_Sources: [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P29](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0029), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P30](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0030), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P33](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0033), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P40](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0040)_
